title: Chicken Marsala
description: Golden chicken cutlets in a savory mushroom and Marsala wine sauce finished with a little butter. A classic that takes 35 minutes.

image.alt: Chicken cutlets in a mushroom Marsala sauce with parsley

steps.text: Slice each breast horizontally into two thin cutlets and press them to an even thickness. Season with the salt and pepper and dredge in the flour.
Heat the oil and 1 tbsp butter in the skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the cutlets in batches until golden and cooked through, {time 3 min} per side. Move to a plate.
Add the mushrooms to the pan and cook without stirring until browned underneath, {time 3 min}, then stir and cook until tender, {time 3 min}. Add the shallot and garlic for {time 1 min}.
Pour in the Marsala and scrape up the browned bits. Simmer until reduced by half, {time 3-4 min}, then add the broth and simmer until slightly thickened, {time 3 min}.
Off the heat, swirl in the remaining butter. Return the chicken and turn it in the sauce, then scatter with parsley. Serve with mashed potatoes or pasta.

notes: Use dry Marsala, not sweet, for a savory sauce.
